findings.description: The condition requires every argument to have help, so a command with both documented and undocumented arguments loses its entire positional arguments section. Use an `any` check to show all arguments when at least one is documented.
findings.rationale: For a command with two arguments where one has help text and the other has `help=None`, `all(...)` returns false and skips formatting entirely. Users lose the previously displayed argument documentation, and the new empty-description fallback is never reached for undocumented arguments.
